title: braves place lane thomas ribs injured list  flm 2026 09 11
text:
Sep 11 (Field Level Media) - The Atlanta Braves placed outfielder Lane Thomas on the 10-day injured list ​Friday with a strained left intercostal ‌muscle.
Thomas, 31, was a late scratch before Thursday's 3-1 win against the Tampa ​Bay Rays. His designation is ​retroactive to Tuesday.
Acquired in a trade ⁠with the Kansas City Royals on ​Aug. 2, Thomas is hitting .171 with ​a homer and three RBIs in 21 games with Atlanta.
For the season, he is batting .224 ​with 11 homers and 40 RBIs ​in 118 games with the Royals and Braves.
Atlanta ‌recalled ⁠outfielder DaShawn Keirsey Jr. from Triple-A Gwinnett in a corresponding transaction before Friday's series opener against visiting Philadelphia. ​The Braves ​enter ⁠the series with a four-game lead over the Phillies in ​the National League East standings.
Keirsey, ​29, ⁠last played in the majors with the Minnesota Twins in 2025. He ⁠is ​batting .247 with six homers, ​36 RBIs and 40 stolen bases in 109 ​games at Gwinnett this season.
--Field Level Media
